core_claim.P: When fulfilling a redeem request, the contract does not check that totalAssets() is greater than the amount being fulfilled for redemption.
core_claim.I: totalAssets() must exceed the redeemed amount so that share price calculations (convertNormalizedAssetsToShares via getCirculatingSupplyAndAssets) use correct circulating supply and assets.
core_claim.V: totalAssets() returns zero when current balance minus reserved totalClaimableRedeemAssets is negative, causing incorrect share calculation and griefing/DoS.

distinct_impacts.description: A new depositor receives far fewer shares than the correct amount (e.g., 10,000 shares instead of 100,000) because totalAssets() returns zero and the share price is miscalculated.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the number of shares the user will get is calculated as: 1_00_000 × 10_000 / 1_00_000, which is 10_000 shares. This is incorrect, as the user should have received 1_00_000 shares at the proper price.

distinct_impacts.description: Share price manipulation resulting from the incorrect share calculation.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This will lead to share price manipulation and griefing (DoS) for users.

distinct_impacts.description: A user attempting to withdraw before another deposit occurs has their transaction revert due to insufficient funds, constituting griefing/DoS.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: if User 1 tries to withdraw before someone deposits 1_00_000, User 1's transaction will revert due to insufficient funds.

distinct_impacts.description: totalAssets() returns zero because current balance minus reserved totalClaimableRedeemAssets is negative, which feeds the incorrect share calculation.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: totalAssets() will return zero because the current_balance (10_000) minus the reserved amount (totalClaimableRedeemAssets of 1_00_000) is less than zero.
